searchText: Is this still the right reference implementation? https://github.com/vulcanize/go-ethereum-EIP1559 No, <@!508125616940515329>. I'm not sure the latest Geth one is public. <@!543900561460822016> was working on it, but he's been very busy with other stuff lately 😅 Besu has an up to date implementation, I believe, and maybe Nethermind too Thanks, I will use Besu as reference implementation. But it would be extremely helpful if we can get 1559 tests in ethereum/tests soon, because I am only confident that our implementation is correct if they pass the "official" tests Yep, I think <@!574864862338088960> is still ironing out a few bugs in Besu, but we can start working on tests after that is done 👍 <@!508125616940515329> you can track our implementation here: https://github.com/quilt/go-ethereum/pull/37 Thanks 🙂 Is the gas pricing scheme for the access lists the same as EIP 2930? This is not clear from the EIP, it does not state any gas charges for the access lists or if it should follow EIP2930 hmm, that's a good point it should be clearly specified in the EIP i haven't implemented any deviation in gas costs for 1559 access lists So you charge 0 gas for access lists or use the EIP2930 costs? sorry, to be clear i use the same schedule as eip2930

excerpts.author: jochembrouwer
excerpts.content: Is this still the right reference implementation? https://github.com/vulcanize/go-ethereum-EIP1559

excerpts.author: timbeiko
excerpts.content:
No, <@!508125616940515329>. I'm not sure the latest Geth one is public. <@!543900561460822016> was working on it, but he's been very busy with other stuff lately 😅 

Besu has an up to date implementation, I believe, and maybe Nethermind too

excerpts.author: jochembrouwer
excerpts.content: Thanks, I will use Besu as reference implementation. But it would be extremely helpful if we can get 1559 tests in ethereum/tests soon, because I am only confident that our implementation is correct if they pass the "official" tests

excerpts.author: timbeiko
excerpts.content: Yep, I think <@!574864862338088960> is still ironing out a few bugs in Besu, but we can start working on tests after that is done 👍

excerpts.author: lightclient
excerpts.content: <@!508125616940515329> you can track our implementation here: https://github.com/quilt/go-ethereum/pull/37

excerpts.author: jochembrouwer
excerpts.content: Is the gas pricing scheme for the access lists the same as EIP 2930?

excerpts.author: jochembrouwer
excerpts.content: This is not clear from the EIP, it does not state any gas charges for the access lists or if it should follow EIP2930

excerpts.author: lightclient
excerpts.content: hmm, that's a good point it should be clearly specified in the EIP

excerpts.author: lightclient
excerpts.content: i haven't implemented any deviation in gas costs for 1559 access lists

excerpts.author: jochembrouwer
excerpts.content: So you charge 0 gas for access lists or use the EIP2930 costs?

excerpts.author: lightclient
excerpts.content: sorry, to be clear i use the same schedule as eip2930
